strategy.summary: CART-12 prices the cart at checkout with a 10% bulk discount (10+ items), the SAVE5 coupon (applied after the bulk discount, floored at $0, unknown codes refused) and shipping ($4.99, free from $50 of discounted goods, nothing for an empty cart). src/cart.js already implements this in cartTotal/bulkDiscount; unit tests through cartTotal must prove each rule and its boundaries. Reading the code shows bulkDiscount uses `itemCount > BULK_THRESHOLD`, so exactly 10 items get no discount, contradicting AC1; that case is expected to fail and will be reported as a defect.
inScope: cartTotal(items, { coupon }) in src/cart.js: bulk discount, coupon, shipping, empty cart
Boundaries: 9/10 items, $50 of discounted goods, coupon larger than the goods
outOfScope: Any UI or API around checkout (none exists in the repo)
assumptions: Totals are rounded to cents as cartTotal does; amounts are compared with toBe on values chosen to be exact in cents
Coupon codes are case-sensitive (only the exact code SAVE5 is accepted), as the code does
When goods are floored at $0 for a non-empty cart, shipping of $4.99 still applies (goods < $50), as the code does
openQuestions: AC1 says 10 or more items get the discount; the code applies it only above 10 (`>` instead of `>=`). Tests follow the ticket and mark the 10-item case expected-to-fail.

risks.description: Off-by-one on the bulk threshold (already present in the code)
risks.mitigation: TC1 (exactly 10 items over several lines) and TC2 (9 items)

risks.description: Coupon applied before the bulk discount changes the price
risks.mitigation: TC3 uses amounts where the order gives different totals

risks.description: Shipping decided on the subtotal instead of discounted goods
risks.mitigation: TC6 reaches exactly $50 only after the coupon

acceptanceCriteria.text: A cart with 10 or more items in total (sum of line quantities) gets 10% off its subtotal; fewer items get no bulk discount.
Coupon SAVE5 takes $5 off after the bulk discount, the goods never cost less than $0, and any other coupon code is refused with an error.
Shipping is free when goods cost $50 or more after discounts, otherwise $4.99; an empty cart costs $0.

defects.title: Bulk discount not applied to a cart of exactly 10 items
defects.description: AC1: carts with 10 or more items get 10% off. src/cart.js:22 bulkDiscount checks `itemCount(items) > BULK_THRESHOLD` (10), so a cart of exactly 10 items gets no discount. Expected cartTotal of 10 x $10 = 90; actual 100.
defects.evidence: it.fails test 'gives 10% off a cart of exactly 10 items spread over several lines' passes, meaning expect(cartTotal(...)).toBe(90) fails (received 100); code reads `itemCount(items) > BULK_THRESHOLD`.
